title: Colored Nether Portals
description: Dye your nether portals any color.
body:
# Colored Nether Portals

**Dye your nether portals any color.**

Right-click a nether portal with any dye and the portal will update to that color. Supports custom texture packs. 

![All 16 portal colors](https://github.com/HashDuckZ/Colored-Nether-Portals/raw/main/Images/Banner.webp)


## How to use

1. Build and light a nether portal as normal.
2. Hold any dye and right-click the portal.

## Images

![Pink portal](https://github.com/HashDuckZ/Colored-Nether-Portals/raw/main/Images/Cherry.webp)
![Lime portal](https://github.com/HashDuckZ/Colored-Nether-Portals/raw/main/Images/Lash.webp)
![Red portal](https://github.com/HashDuckZ/Colored-Nether-Portals/raw/main/Images/Lava.webp)

## Compatibility

Available for **Fabric** and **NeoForge**.
